requirements.summary: Separate capture/client, application API, data/media and external recognition/data boundaries support a bounded software fixture.
Grocery field review is distinct from dropshipping; shared adapter/media/task/history mechanisms do not combine their products.
Field visits inspect product presence/promotion and prioritize effort using product value/KPI information; current workflow details are background.
requirements.remainingWork: Confirm the first journey and implement visit/task/review/reporting behavior with permitted data; no promised stock counts, priorities or KPI outcomes.

requirements.summary: Consented/reference image and known reference data can produce candidate matches, human corrections and a recorded prioritized result.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4b must implement ingestion, human correction, uncertainty and priority calculation. Synthetic doubles exercise surrounding behavior only.

source.location: To fill in / phone/tablet versus glasses

requirements.summary: Device choice, supported capture controls, first journey and AR/real-time interface are unresolved; no phone/glasses/robot choice is adopted.
requirements.remainingWork: Owner must settle device and first journey before device implementation. The robot speculation in the concept is not a requirement.

source.location: Data sources available / Retailmotus and Trax context

requirements.summary: Source vendors are context only; access to APIs, product value, private KPI, retailer/backroom stock or photos is not assumed.
requirements.remainingWork: Establish lawful/authorized available sources, API permissions and data contracts first. Public synthetic fixtures grant no vendor access.

requirements.summary: Recognition quality requires labeled/held-out data, latency/cost measurement and field evidence. A deterministic double cannot establish accuracy.
requirements.remainingWork: Keep uncertain matches uncertain; define evaluation criteria and gather independent evidence before claiming recognition performance or real stock counts.

requirements.summary: Shelf label types and future digital labels are unresolved background, not specified parser inputs or guaranteed device capabilities.
requirements.remainingWork: Resolve label/input formats and availability without inventing camera/reader hardware, vendor models or parsing accuracy.

source.location: Shared reusable capabilities / first software fixture

requirements.summary: Media handling, optional captured-location metadata, operator tasks and activity history need application-specific consent/access and data rules.
requirements.remainingWork: Implement permitted capture/upload, current access, retention, review history and any optional location integration. No production privacy/access policy is established by a private resource setting.

requirements.summary: No full-product, deployed integration or recognition result follows from design coverage.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a/C4b field tests must verify reproducible foundations, integration failures and human correction independently; the concept remains explicitly limited.
